Plane mirrors form virtual, erect, same-size images. Refraction is bending of light when it passes from one medium to another. Lenses converge or diverge light rays. competency.question: A schoolbag strap is made wide. Explain how this design choice uses the relationship P = F/A.
competency.official_answer: For the same force (weight of the bag), a larger area of the strap reduces pressure on the shoulder, making it more comfortable.

hots.question: Why do plant cells have a large vacuole while most animal cells do not? Give a reasoned answer.
hots.official_answer: The large vacuole stores water and maintains turgor pressure that supports the plant cell; animal cells rely on a cytoskeleton and do not need the same turgidity for rigidity.
